ability.name: Cruel Taskmaster
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Flesh-eater Courts^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Stronger in Madness
ability.effect:
Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.
In addition, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.

ability.name: Savage Beyond Reason
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, if it did not use a **^^Fight^^** ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this battle.
